maximum.pngs: every PNG independently decoded, all alpha255, four moving artwork/four image samples in every frame

native.privateViewer: strict fixture-CA HTTPS native download, all12PNG checked; archive excludes setup/read/revoke capabilities
native.lifecycle: Genuine worker cancellation after frame progress and controlled pagehide in both editor and strict-HTTPS private viewer; owned workers terminate without late downloads. Private complete project backup stays exact.
native.capacity: valid ancillary padding admits an exact96MiB archive and rejects+1 before retaining the final frame

failures.detail: Standard Playwright download returned a truncated ZIP; no product or security flags changed. A separately installed npm Chromium package was decompressed locally for native tests.
Truncated33-byte PNG and internalCRC damage initially entered writer. Added actual PNG structure/EOF and chunkCRC checks; original regression then passed.

limits: The archive carries rendered frames rather than editable project data.
Ancillary capacity padding tests bounded byte admission, not peak memory or general encoding latency.
